name: GIRDER 格拉德 Titanium MTB 2025 27.5 XT 1×12
why_interesting: A titanium 27.5-inch hardtail complete with XT 1×12 rear derailleur at an official ¥8,800; listed in one 17-inch size.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 1×12; XT RD-M8100 rear derailleur, Deore FC-MT510-1 34T 170 mm crank, Deore CS-M6100-12 cassette (written 'CS-6100-12'); shifter and chain not listed
facts.frame: 27.5-inch titanium hardtail frame, internal routing, 12×148 mm Boost rear thru-axle, UDH dropout, anodized segmented-colour finish
facts.frame_material: 3Al-2.5V titanium frame; tube butting and wall thickness are not published
facts.fork: SR Suntour Boost 110 fork; the page states 120 mm travel. Model, damper, axle and lockout details are not listed
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 86.5 mm shell width, 52×52 mm bearing cups
facts.wheels: Aluminium double-wall rims, four-bearing thru-axle hubs
facts.tires: Maxxis 27.5×2.2 fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: 3Al-2.5V titanium tapered flat handlebar; welded 6Al-4V titanium stem
facts.sizes: 27.5 × 17 in only on the product page
facts.geometry: Official chart for 15/17/19 in (17 in listed for sale): seat tube 381/430/480 mm, top tube 587/615/638 mm, chainstay 426 mm, seat angle 73°, head angle 69.5°, wheelbase 1088/1116/1140 mm, BB drop 56 mm, head tube 90/100/110 mm, stack 596/606/615 mm; reach is not given
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated

missing: Exact fork model and whether travel is 110 mm or 120 mm

Current mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount, warranty issuer, warranty term and invoice handling

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed price on the exact NEW 2025 Titanium alloy MTB page; no mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount was observed
